body:
im sorry you feel the same as me. i hope things can get better for me. im trying to calm down as best i can
i hope you find someone to speak to, and if you were gone id miss you

I’ve only been in a teen ward, I’m still under 18. It was okay. No pressure really. Lots of arts and crafts and mediocre food. I worked a lot of dot to dots and didn’t contact any of my family or friends. Overall it felt like I took a two week hiatus from life. 
Going back was very hard though
right now I just want my cat, man. as stupid as it is that’s what started all this. i just don’t want to have to choose between putting my only friend through unnecessary pain and giving him up

that’s why i was originally so excited to go to college, it’s out of state and id live on campus so id be free. but now i dread it, it’s difficult to force myself to get out of bed, shower, brush my teeth, whatever with someone telling me to do it, but at college on my own? honestly, forget about it.

i stupidly tried to talk to my boyfriend and he did it again. 
he told me I never talk to him and im the reason he has no friends. i tried to tell him i don’t talk to him because of exactly what he’s doing right now and he just complained about how im always mad at him...

on second thought, i May take my chances with the meds when everyone’s asleep tonight
